content.user_title: Maintain AI Agents and Project Context with moldea
content.value_statement: Agent instructions and project decisions can drift as implementation changes. moldea guides scoped context maintenance, agent design, and repository validation.
actual_capabilities: Plan agent responsibilities, instruction sources, output schemas, tools, and runtime connections.
Maintain canonical project context and declared relationships between source paths and context owners.
Gate context access using adoption checks and path-based relationship matching.
Validate repository format, declared file bindings, and integration diagnostics through a repository-local CLI.
Update managed README and agent instruction regions while preserving surrounding content.
Guide explicit initialization and repair with dependency preflight and lifecycle scripts disabled.
limitations: Project validation requires compatible repository-local CLI and Core packages, Node.js, and Git.
Manifest validation and file checks do not prove runtime instruction consumption or live model behavior.
The launcher is not a sandbox and does not authenticate repository-installed executable bytes.
Security review covers 400 representative alerts; 6,283 additional static matches still require manual review.

use_cases.title: Design a Focused Agent System
use_cases.description: Compare agent responsibilities, shared context, and runtime boundaries before authorizing implementation.

use_cases.title: Keep Context Aligned with Code
use_cases.description: Assess declared context owners after a relevant code change and update only contradicted facts within the authorized scope.

use_cases.title: Repair Project Integration
use_cases.description: Diagnose an existing moldea setup, review local tooling prerequisites, and validate authorized repairs without changing unrelated project files.

prompt_templates.title: Review One Agent
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the named agent [agent name] without changing files. Report instruction ownership, declared bindings, and any unverified runtime connections.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: read-only assessment of an existing adopted project

prompt_templates.title: Initialize Project Context
prompt_templates.prompt: Initialize moldea for this repository using established project evidence. Preserve existing controls and ask about missing purpose or boundaries before dependency or foundation changes.

prompt_templates.title: Reconcile a Relevant Change
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess the declared context relationships for [changed paths]. Update only contradicted owners within this task's authority, preserve unrelated work, and validate after the final write.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: context maintenance after implementation changes

prompt_templates.title: Plan Agent Runtime Connections
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a read-only plan for [workflow]. Trace instruction, output schema, and tool ownership to the selected runtime; separate verified connections from unknown boundaries.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: agent architecture and runtime connection analysis

output_examples.input: Review a named support agent without making changes.
output: Illustrative review: The instruction owner is identified and the declared export exists.
The outgoing request was not tested, so runtime instruction consumption remains unverified.

output_examples.input: Assess context after a related source change.
output: Illustrative maintenance result: The matched context owner remains accurate.
Canonical content and manifest relationships are unchanged.
No broader context inspection was required.

output_examples.input: Initialize a repository whose purpose is unclear.
output: Illustrative blocked result: The inspected sources do not establish the project purpose.
No dependencies, foundation files, or managed document regions changed.
What does the project do, and who does it serve?

best_practices: Start with a named agent, explicit initialization request, or a bounded set of relevant source paths.
Preserve repository trust controls and review dependency changes before executing local tooling.
Separate structural validation, semantic alignment, and runtime test evidence in every completion report.
anti_patterns: Do not initialize projects or install dependencies during unrelated or read-only work.
Do not treat a valid manifest as proof that runtime behavior consumes the declared instructions.
Do not persist secrets, transient status, speculative policies, or broad relationships without supporting evidence.

faq.question: Which assistants can use moldea?
faq.answer: The skill supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code. Available execution controls and repository permissions still depend on the host.

faq.question: Does moldea initialize every repository automatically?
faq.answer: No. Initialization requires an explicit request and sufficient project evidence; ordinary repository work also requires relevant adoption or relationship evidence.

faq.question: What local tooling does project validation require?
faq.answer: The documented contract requires Node.js 22.17.0 or later, Git 2.32.0 or later, CLI 13.x, and Core 9.x.

faq.question: Can I review an agent without changing files?
faq.answer: Yes. Read-only planning and evaluation preserve repository state and do not authorize installation or dependency changes.

faq.question: Does successful validation prove the agent works?
faq.answer: No. Validation checks repository structure and declared file bindings; runtime connections and live behavior require separate source evidence and focused tests.

faq.question: Has this security review cleared every static match?
faq.answer: No. The 400 presented alerts were adjudicated, but 6,283 omitted matches require manual review before automatic publication.
